text_block_list.text:
Overwhelmed by Silence Suzuka's sheer 
talent, Air Groove falls into a slump. To 
help her bounce back, the Trainer sits 
down to have an honest talk with her.

The Trainer tells her: Air Groove is a 
"challenger" who continues to take on 
challenges to become the "ideal" for all 
Umamusume.

Furthermore, seeing Mejiro Dober continue 
her tireless efforts with Air Groove as 
her "ideal" opened Air Groove's eyes.

No matter how high or daunting the 
obstacle, Air Groove stood up, determined 
to overcome it.

First, off to the Sapporo Kinen for her 
resurgence. To demonstrate her "ideals" as 
the "Empress"... Her renewed challenge has 
begun!
